description: Convert a recorded birth time (wall clock + IANA time zone + longitude) into true solar time — the time a BaZi / Four Pillars chart should actually be cast from. Returns the corrected instant, the total correction decomposed into DST + longitude + equation-of-time (the three always sum exactly), the resulting two-hour branch, distance to the nearest branch boundary, and whether the reported clock time even existed (spring-forward DST gaps, e.g. China 1986–91). Deterministic: same input, same output, every time.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in degrees, east positive (Ürümqi ≈ 87.6, Vancouver ≈ -123.1)

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. 'Asia/Shanghai', 'America/Vancouver'

name: true_solar_time

boundaryRisk.description: Within 8 min of a boundary — cast both candidate hours

correctedTime.description: True solar time at the birthplace — cast the chart from this

correctionMinutes.description: Total correction relative to the reported wall-clock time

hourBranch.description: Two-hour branch (子丑寅…) the corrected time falls in

longitude.description: Longitude normalized to within ±180° of the zone standard meridian

minutesToBoundary.description: Minutes to the nearest hour-branch boundary; 0 = exactly on it

neighborBranch.description: Branch on the other side of the nearest boundary

gapMinutes.description: Width of the gap in minutes; 0 when hit is false

hit.description: True if the reported clock time never existed (spring-forward DST gap)

parts.description: The three components always sum exactly to correctionMinutes

timeZone.description: IANA zone the correction was computed against

title: True solar time correction
